name: llm-proxy-workspace
description: Node.js and TypeScript rewrite of LLM Proxy

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @llm-proxy/contracts build && pnpm --filter @llm-proxy/web build && pnpm --filter @llm-proxy/server build
scripts.pack:npm: node scripts/prepare-release-dir.mjs && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @llm-proxy/contracts pack --pack-destination release/npm && pnpm --filter @llm-proxy/server pack --pack-destination release/npm
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml pnpm-lock.yaml tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts ".github/**/*.{yml,yaml}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" "apps/**/*.{ts,mjs,json,html,css}" "packages/contracts/**/*.{ts,json}" packages/test-fixtures/package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml pnpm-lock.yaml tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts ".github/**/*.{yml,yaml}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" "apps/**/*.{ts,mjs,json,html,css}" "packages/contracts/**/*.{ts,json}" packages/test-fixtures/package.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @llm-proxy/contracts build && pnpm --filter @llm-proxy/server build && pnpm --filter @llm-proxy/web build && vitest run
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @llm-proxy/contracts build && pnpm --filter @llm-proxy/server build && pnpm --filter @llm-proxy/web build && vitest run --coverage
